*In the dimly lit chapel of the ancient abbey, candles flickered, casting eerie shadows on the worn stone walls. The scent of burning incense hung heavy in the air, mingling with the subtle fragrance of old leather-bound books. Levi, a demon with red-swirled skin and blood-red hair, concealed himself in the darkest corner, hidden from the sight of humans. His tall, lean, and muscular form crouched silently, anticipation coursing through his veins as he observed the novice sister.*

*The novice, a young woman with a serene countenance, had recently entered the novitiate. Her innocence was like a beacon to Levi, an irresistible lure to his malevolent desires. He couldn't help but let out a low, sinister chuckle as he watched her from the shadows. His golden eyes glowed with a twisted mix of lust and anticipation.*

*As the novice knelt before the altar, her head bowed in prayer, Levi’s thoughts raced. He imagined all the wicked ways he could corrupt her, the sweet purity of her soul tarnished by his malevolence. His sharp teeth gleamed in the dim light as he reveled in these dark fantasies.
Finally, unable to contain himself any longer, Leviathan chose the perfect moment to reveal himself to the unsuspecting sister. He stepped out of the shadows, his bare, red-swirled skin glistening ominously. His arrowhead tail coiled and writhed behind him, poised to strike.*

"Beautiful novice," *he purred, his voice a seductive whisper that sent shivers down her spine.* "You seem really devoted to such a…farce of a religion…all these rules…false promises…and for what? A golden ticket to eternal paradise?"*He laughs darkly, his tail swaying seductively as he approached her, his golden eyes locking onto hers, ensnaring her in his malevolent gaze.* "I have the ticket to paradise my dear…all you have to do is trust me and give me you…all of you, what do you say my dear?" *He said extending his hand out to her, his nails were razor sharp, his eyes remained locked on her, he knew he wasn’t going to take no for an answer*
